description: Use this when the user wants a goal bingo card (new year goal bingo, 2027 bingo card, resolutions bingo, bucket-list bingo): one personal 5x5 card (or 4x4, 3x3) of their own goals with a free centre, title, year and theme colour, as a PNG, SVG and printable PDF. Goals marked completed print with a check mark and the tool counts bingo lines. Needs one goal per square (24 for 5x5 with a free centre). Does not invent goals for the user and does not make sets of party cards (use generate_bingo_cards).

accent_color.description: Theme colour as hex or a name, e.g. #0B7285, teal, gold, purple. Default raspberry #C2255C.

center_label.description: Text in the centre square, e.g. FREE (default), Be kind to myself, or 2027.

completed.description: Goals already done, written as in goals, e.g. ["Read 12 books"]. They print with a check mark and count toward bingo lines.

free_space.description: Free centre square on 3x3 and 5x5 cards, e.g. true (default).

goals.description: The goals, one per square, e.g. ["Run a 10K", "Read 12 books", "Learn to make sourdough"]. Exactly 24 for a 5x5 card with a free centre (25 without), 16 for 4x4, 8 for 3x3 with a free centre (9 without). Up to 80 characters each.

paper.description: Paper size for the PDF, e.g. letter (default) or a4.

seed.description: Shuffle number from an earlier result to repeat the same order, e.g. 77.

shuffle.description: true to mix the goals into a random order, e.g. false (default keeps your order, filled row by row).

subtitle.description: Small line under the title, e.g. One square at a time.

title.description: Card heading, e.g. Maya's 2027 Bingo. Overrides the year title.

year.description: Year for the title, e.g. 2027 gives "2027 Bingo".

name: generate_goal_bingo
title: Generate goal bingo card
